subtitle: Code-security scan reviews per repository revision, separated by source. Findings never grant approval or execution authority.
readOnlyBody: Review summaries are bounded. Exact-revision paths, redacted code context, evidence flows, and validated HTML or SARIF appear only when recorded artifacts are available. A scan request never changes code, approves, or executes.
unavailable: Authoritative code-security review evidence is unavailable.
empty: No code-security review has been recorded yet.

gap.code_security_scan_request_malformed: A stored scan request is malformed and was withheld.

scan.title: Repository scans
scan.body: Ask Heimdall to scan a registered repository. The scan worker fetches the exact commit with read-only access, scans it in the sandbox, and records the review here.
scan.queued: Scan request queued. The result appears below when the scan worker finishes.
scan.forbidden: A Contributor or Owner role is required to request a scan.
scan.failed: The scan request was not queued.
scan.noRepositories: No repository is registered for Console scans. An Owner registers one below or with `fdai-code-security repo-register`.
scan.unavailable: Registered repositories and scan requests are unavailable.
scan.requestsEmpty: No scan has been requested yet.

worker.unavailableBody: No fresh code-security worker heartbeat is recorded. {count} queued or running requests remain durable and resume when automation recovers.
worker.nextCheck: Last revision check: {scanned} scanned, {unchanged} unchanged, {failed} failed. Next check: {time}

rejection.requester_role_insufficient: The requester lacked a Contributor or Owner role.
rejection.repository_disabled: Scans of this repository are disabled.
rejection.source_unavailable: The repository or ref could not be fetched.
rejection.scan_failed: The scan failed before producing a review.
rejection.review_conflict: A different review is already recorded for this commit.
rejection.attempts_exhausted: The scan was retried too many times.
rejection.repository_conflict: The alias is already registered for another repository.

register.title: Register a GitHub repository
register.body: Owners can allow Console scans of a GitHub repository. The worker applies the change with an audit record; registering grants no write access to the repository.
register.aliasHint: Suggested from the repository name. Change it only when you need a distinct Console label.
register.locationHint: Paste a GitHub URL or enter owner/repository. FDAI uses read-only source access.
register.queued: Change request queued. It takes effect when the scan worker runs.
register.forbidden: Only an Owner can change repository registrations.
register.failed: The change request was not queued.
register.defaultRefHint: Blank follows the repository's default branch.

issues.title: Issues in this review
issues.body: Review each finding by severity range, confidence, exact fix-site path, weakness class, and scanner evidence. Bounded exact-revision context may appear here; the full source remains in the repository.
issues.notRecorded: Issue details weren't recorded for this review.
issues.summaryArtifact: Full scan artifacts are unavailable. These views are generated from the bounded recorded issue summaries and omit paths and scanner coverage.
issues.severityRangeBody: Current evidence supports a range from {floor} through {ceiling}. FDAI does not choose one band without verified facts.
issues.severityDeterminedBody: Verified facts place this finding at {severity}.
issues.severityFilters: Filter shown issue summaries by severity
issues.reviewRequiredBody: {total} findings recorded; {determined} have a determined severity.
issues.coverageCompleteBody: Every required scanner completed and produced valid evidence.
issues.coverageIncompleteBody: Do not interpret missing findings as a clean result.
issues.coverageLimitsUnknown: The scan recorded incomplete coverage without a detailed scanner reason.
issues.coverageDetailsUnavailable: Full scanner coverage details were not retained for this review.
issues.searchPlaceholder: Title, path, issue id, CWE, package...
issues.noFilterResults: No findings match this severity filter.
issues.codeUnavailable: Code context was not recorded for this finding. Open the exact scanned revision on GitHub.
